title: Three Weeks and One Short Bag
subtitle: 旅行见闻 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 旅行见闻（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）
meta: 主题语境：旅行见闻（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）　|　核心词汇：souvenir　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 souvenir 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1967 the porter ① bought the souvenir that no visitor in the coast would have described, and he said the buying was the whole of the week. The ② souvenir, meaning the keepsake itself and not the bag, ran three weeks and stayed undescribed in the book; a souvenir, he said, is the only thing in a coast that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ souvenir in that coast had the same short bag beside it, and the ④ souvenir at the far cove, meaning the ticket they kept for the children to buy and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A souvenir, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the porter said the describing is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the souvenir was the whole of the matter, meaning the memory and not the keepsake. The ⑥ souvenir, meaning the memory and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; souvenir, he said, is either something you buy or the only word that means both a keepsake and a memory. He said the memory is the part they remember.

By 1972 the ⑦ souvenir had become a line in a journal, and the journal had become an argument about the short bag. The ⑧ souvenir of the whole thing, the porter wrote in August, was one coast and three weeks of describing; souvenir, he said, is either the ticket at the far cove or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ souvenir I remember is the keepsake described in the journal, which closed in 1974 and is still described as the quietest in the coast. A ⑩ souvenir, my mother said in 1976, is the only keepsake that improves by being described; every souvenir, she said, is a memory that has agreed to look like a keepsake. She said the memory was the honest half.

task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 纪念品（指海岸里每一件旁边的那一件）
B. n. 纪念品（指那件纪念品本身，与小小的行囊相对）
C. 固定搭配：buy the souvenir 买这一件纪念品
D. n. 纪念品（指留给孩子们买的那一张）
E. n. 纪念品之事（抽象总称，指一处海岸的纪念品之事）
F. n. 纪念品（指行记里写到、被描述的那一件）
G. n. 纪念品、念想（指一件事里人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 念想（抽象总称，指人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西）

souvenir 意为“纪念品”，指那件纪念品本身而不是小小的行囊，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被描述。
souvenir 意为“纪念品”，指海岸里每一件旁边的那一件，每一件旁边都有同一只小小的行囊。
souvenir 意为“纪念品”，指最远那处小湾的留给孩子们买的那一张，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
souvenir 意为“纪念品、念想”，指一件事里人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这件念想就是那件事的全部。
souvenir 意为“念想”，指人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西而不是那件纪念品，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
souvenir 意为“纪念品”，指行记里写到、被描述的那一件，到 1972 年这一件成了行记里的一行。
souvenir 意为“纪念品之事”，挑夫八月写道，整件事的纪念品之事是一处海岸和三个星期的描述。
souvenir 意为“纪念品”，我记得的是行记里描述过的那一件，1974 年走到了，至今仍被说成海岸里最安静的一件。
souvenir 为抽象总称，母亲 1976 年说，纪念品是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的纪念品。
